Coffee beats tea when you need to wake up.
Headphones on the commute beat dealing with the noise.
Cook when tired beats ordering in.
Paper book beats phone screen when you travel.
Window seat beats aisle — and I would not switch for a friend.
Morning workout beats evening if you keep only one.
One long trip a year beats several short ones.
Handwritten lists beat phone notes for errands.
Walk under twenty minutes beats a short ride.
Local bakery beats the chain on the same block.
Park beats mall on a free afternoon.
Mute the group chat forever beats staying noisy and answering late.
Phone face-down at meals beats checking every buzz.
Cancel a low-stakes plan to rest beats showing up tired.
One extraordinary hobby beats staying casually good at many.
Walk while you think beats sitting by the window.
